acts.name: Act I
acts.subtitle: Something Is Rotten
recap: A ghost says Claudius murdered King Hamlet.
Hamlet swears revenge and plans to act crazy.
Polonius bans Ophelia from seeing Hamlet.

acts.name: Act II
acts.subtitle: The Play's the Thing
recap: Everyone spies on Hamlet to learn why he's 'mad.'
Polonius blames love. R&G are hired snoops.
Hamlet plans a play to test Claudius's guilt.

acts.name: Act III
acts.subtitle: The Mousetrap Snaps
recap: Claudius panics at the play: he's guilty.
Hamlet skips killing him while he prays.
Hamlet stabs Polonius through the curtain.

acts.name: Act IV
acts.subtitle: Rosemary & Rue
recap: Hamlet is shipped to England to be killed.
Ophelia goes mad and drowns. Laertes wants revenge.
Pirates bring Hamlet home. A duel is rigged.

acts.name: Act V
acts.subtitle: The Rest Is Silence
recap: Alas, poor Yorick. Ophelia is buried.
Poisoned blade, poisoned cup: nearly all die.
Fortinbras walks in and takes the throne.

tracks.name: The Battlements
summary: Midnight. Freezing. The guards see a ghost
that looks just like the dead king.
beats: 'Who's there?' Jumpy guards, freezing night.
Horatio says ghosts aren't real. Then: ghost.
It looks exactly like the dead King Hamlet!
Norway's Fortinbras wants his dad's land back.
The rooster crows. The ghost bolts.
Plan: tell young Hamlet. He'll get it to talk.

questions.q: Who do the guards bring to see the ghost?
Why do the guards want Horatio to speak to the ghost?
Whom does the ghost look exactly like?
Why is Denmark getting ready for war?
What does young Fortinbras want from Denmark?
What makes the ghost vanish before it can speak?
Horatio fears the ghost is a sign of what?
Why do they decide to tell young Hamlet about the ghost?
What mood does the play's opening scene set?
What do Fortinbras and young Hamlet have in common?

tracks.name: Claudius's Court
summary: Claudius is king AND wed Hamlet's mom,
about a month after the funeral. Awkward.
beats: King Claudius: 'Sad funeral! Happy wedding!'
Messengers go to Norway to stop Fortinbras.
Laertes may go back to France. Fun for him.
Hamlet, in black, may NOT go back to school.
Hamlet alone: Mom remarried in a month?!
Horatio: 'So... we saw your dead dad.'

questions.q: Who has married Hamlet's mother?
How soon after the funeral did Gertrude remarry?
Why is Hamlet still dressed in black at court?
What does Claudius say about Hamlet's long grief?
Why won't Claudius let Hamlet go back to school?
Alone, what does Hamlet wish in his first soliloquy?
In his first soliloquy, what upsets Hamlet most?
'Frailty, thy name is woman.' Who is Hamlet blaming?
What does Hamlet decide after Horatio tells him about the ghost?
'A little more than kin, and less than kind.' Who said it?

tracks.name: Polonius's Advice
summary: Laertes and Polonius both tell Ophelia
to stay away from Hamlet. Rude.
beats: Laertes packs for France. One last lecture.
'Hamlet's a prince. He can't pick who he marries.'
Polonius arrives with a LOT of advice.
'Don't borrow or lend money.'
'To your own self be true.'
Polonius to Ophelia: stop seeing Hamlet.

questions.q: Why does Laertes say Hamlet can't freely choose a wife?
What does Laertes warn Ophelia to protect?
How does Ophelia answer her brother's lecture?
What kind of advice does Polonius give Laertes?
Polonius tells Laertes: 'To thine own self be...'
What does Polonius order Ophelia to do about Hamlet?
Why does Polonius distrust Hamlet's vows of love?
How does Ophelia answer her father's order?
What does Act I, Scene 3 show about Ophelia's life?
Where is Laertes about to travel?

tracks.name: The Ghost Speaks
summary: The ghost tells Hamlet the truth:
Claudius murdered him. Revenge time.
beats: Hamlet waits on the walls. Claudius parties.
The ghost waves Hamlet over. Friends: don't!
'Something is rotten in the state of Denmark.'
Ghost: Claudius poured poison in my ear!
'Remember me!' Hamlet swears revenge.
Hamlet: 'I might act crazy. Play along.'

questions.q: 'Something is rotten in the state of Denmark.' Who said it?
Why do Hamlet's friends try to stop him following the ghost?
How did Claudius kill King Hamlet?
What story was told about the old king's death?
What does the ghost ask Hamlet to do?
Besides murder, what does the ghost blame Claudius for?
What does the ghost tell Hamlet to do about Gertrude?
What does Hamlet make his friends swear to do?
What does Hamlet warn he might pretend to be?
'The time is out of joint.' What does Hamlet mean?

tracks.name: Reynaldo the Spy
summary: Polonius sends a spy after his own son,
then decides Hamlet is crazy in love.
beats: Polonius hires Reynaldo to spy on Laertes.
Plan: spread small rumors, see what's true.
Ophelia runs in, scared.
Hamlet came in a mess, stared, and left!
Polonius: 'He's mad with love for you!'
Off to tell the king. Bad idea, Polonius.

questions.q: Why does Polonius send his servant Reynaldo to Paris?
How should Reynaldo find out about Laertes?
What does the Reynaldo plan show about Polonius?
Why is Ophelia frightened at the start of Act II?
How does Hamlet look when he visits Ophelia?
What does Hamlet do in Ophelia's room?
What does Polonius think made Hamlet mad?
Why does Polonius regret his order to Ophelia?
After hearing Ophelia's story, what does Polonius do?
Hamlet's strange visit to Ophelia may be part of what?

tracks.name: The Players Arrive
summary: Spies everywhere. Then actors arrive,
and Hamlet gets an idea.
beats: The king hires Hamlet's pals R&G to spy.
Polonius: 'Brevity is the soul of wit.' (He isn't brief.)
Hamlet calls Polonius a fish seller. Burn.
R&G admit they were sent for. Busted.
The actors arrive! An actor cries over a story.
'The play's the thing to catch the king.'

questions.q: Why did the king send for Rosencrantz and Guildenstern?
What news comes back from Norway?
Why is it funny that Polonius says 'Brevity is the soul of wit'?
How does Polonius plan to test his love theory?
What does Hamlet get Rosencrantz and Guildenstern to admit?
An actor weeps over an old story. How does it make Hamlet feel?
Why does Hamlet want the actors to put on a play?
Why won't Hamlet just trust what the ghost said?
'The play's the thing wherein I'll catch the conscience of the...'
'Though this be madness, yet there is method in't.' Who said it?

tracks.name: To Be or Not to Be
summary: Hamlet wonders whether to live or die.
Ophelia gets an earful. Spies take notes.
beats: R&G report: no clue why Hamlet's acting weird.
The king and Polonius hide to spy. Again.
'To be, or not to be: that is the question.'
Fear of what's after death keeps us going.
Ophelia returns his gifts: 'Get thee to a nunnery!'
King: not love. Ship Hamlet off to England.

questions.q: What question is 'To be or not to be' asking?
In 'To be or not to be,' what makes death so frightening?
'Conscience does make ___ of us all.'
Who hides with Polonius to watch Hamlet meet Ophelia?
Why is Ophelia sent to meet Hamlet?
What does Ophelia try to give back to Hamlet?
'Get thee to a nunnery.' What is Hamlet telling Ophelia?
Why does Claudius doubt that Hamlet is mad with love?
After spying on Hamlet, what does Claudius decide?
'O, what a noble mind is here o'erthrown!' Who said it?

tracks.name: The Mousetrap
summary: The play shows a murder just like
the real one. The king freaks out.
beats: Hamlet coaches the actors: don't overact!
Horatio's job: watch the king's face.
Hamlet names the play 'The Mousetrap.'
'The lady doth protest too much, methinks.'
Poison in the ear! The king storms out!
Hamlet: 'I'll take the ghost's word now.'

questions.q: What is Hamlet's main advice to the actors?
Why does Hamlet trust Horatio above everyone?
Whom does Hamlet ask to watch the king's face?
Why does Hamlet call the play 'The Mousetrap'?
In the play, how is the sleeping king killed?
'The lady doth protest too much.' What does Gertrude mean?
What does Claudius do when the poisoning is acted out?
To Hamlet, what does the king's reaction prove?
Hamlet hands Guildenstern a pipe to play. What is his point?
'I will speak daggers to her, but use none.' What does Hamlet mean?

tracks.name: Claudius Prays
summary: Claudius admits his crime, alone.
Hamlet could strike... and doesn't.
beats: Claudius: R&G, take Hamlet to England. Now.
Polonius will hide in the queen's room.
Claudius alone: 'My offense is rank!'
He can't be sorry. He'd have to give it all back.
Hamlet finds him praying. Sword up...
Not now: he'd go to heaven. Hamlet waits.

questions.q: Alone at prayer, what does Claudius admit?
Why can't Claudius be forgiven, in his own words?
Why won't Hamlet kill Claudius at prayer? His soul would...
Hamlet spares the praying king. What's the irony?
'My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.' What does Claudius mean?
Why does Claudius want Hamlet out of Denmark?
Who will take Hamlet to England?
Where does Polonius plan to hide and listen?
Which habit of Hamlet's does the prayer scene show?
'O, my offence is rank, it smells to heaven.' Who said it?

tracks.name: The Closet
summary: Hamlet confronts his mother.
Someone behind the curtain: big mistake.
beats: Polonius hides behind the arras (curtain).
Hamlet is rough on Gertrude. She yells help!
'How now, a rat?' Stab through the curtain!
Oops. It was Polonius, not the king.
The ghost returns. Only Hamlet sees it.
Hamlet drags the body off. Grim exit.

questions.q: Who hides behind the tapestry in Gertrude's room?
How does Polonius give himself away?
Whom does Hamlet hope he has stabbed?
Hamlet shows Gertrude two pictures. Of whom?
What does Hamlet beg Gertrude to do?
Why does the ghost come back in Gertrude's room?
Why does Gertrude think Hamlet is mad?
What does Hamlet tell Gertrude about his madness?
Hamlet kills Polonius in a flash. Whom has he put off killing?
What does Hamlet do with Polonius's body?

tracks.name: Where's Polonius?
summary: Hamlet hid the body and won't say where.
The king's secret plan: England = death.
beats: Gertrude tells the king: Hamlet killed Polonius!
R&G hunt for the body. Hamlet: 'You're a sponge.'
Hamlet runs off. Hide-and-seek, castle edition.
Where's Polonius? 'At supper.' (Worms' supper.)
Check the stairs to the lobby. Pee-yew.
Secret letter: England, please kill Hamlet.

questions.q: How does Gertrude describe Hamlet to Claudius?
By calling Hamlet mad, what is Gertrude doing?
What does Claudius realize when he hears Polonius is dead?
Why does Hamlet call Rosencrantz a sponge?
How does Hamlet talk about Polonius's death?
Hamlet says Polonius is 'at supper.' What does he mean?
'A king may go a progress through the guts of a beggar.' Hamlet's point?
Why can't Claudius punish Hamlet openly?
What does the king's sealed letter ask England to do?
'Not where he eats, but where he is eaten.' Who said it?

tracks.name: Fortinbras's Army
summary: Thousands march to fight for a worthless
patch of land. Hamlet feels lazy.
beats: Fortinbras's army marches through Denmark.
Target: a tiny, worthless patch of Poland.
Hamlet: they'll die for THAT?
Meanwhile, I have a real reason, and wait.
'My thoughts be bloody, or be nothing worth!'
Off to England anyway. Plot twist incoming.

questions.q: Where is Fortinbras's army marching?
What will Fortinbras's army fight over?
Who tells Hamlet the land is worthless?
How does the army make Hamlet feel?
Why does the army shame Hamlet?
What troubles Hamlet about the soldiers?
How is Fortinbras a foil to Hamlet?
'From this time forth, my thoughts be ___ or be nothing worth!'
Whose death does Fortinbras want to make up for?
Where is Hamlet headed when he meets the army?

tracks.name: Ophelia's Madness
summary: Ophelia loses her mind with grief.
Laertes storms in, wanting blood.
beats: Ophelia sings strange, sad songs.
The king: 'Sorrows come in battalions.'
A mob! Laertes bursts in, wants revenge!
Claudius stays calm: 'I didn't do it.'
Rosemary for remembrance. Pansies for thoughts.
Laertes sees his sister. Revenge, doubled.

questions.q: What has driven Ophelia mad?
How was Polonius buried?
What does Ophelia hand out at court?
Ophelia's flowers carry meanings. What is rosemary for?
What do Ophelia's songs keep returning to?
Who storms the castle with an angry crowd?
What does the angry crowd shout for?
Claudius says God protects kings. Why is that ironic?
How is Laertes a foil to Hamlet?
'When sorrows come, they come not single spies, but in battalions.' Who said it?

tracks.name: Pirates & the Brook
summary: Pirates return Hamlet. The duel is rigged.
Then: sad news by the brook.
beats: A letter! Pirates attacked Hamlet's ship!
Hamlet's back in Denmark. R&G sail on.
Claudius & Laertes plot a fake fencing match.
Sharp blade + poison tip + poisoned cup.
Gertrude: Ophelia fell from a willow...
...and drowned in the brook. Laertes weeps.

questions.q: How does Hamlet escape the ship to England?
Who gets Hamlet's letter about the pirates?
How do Claudius and Laertes plan to kill Hamlet?
Why does Claudius want Hamlet's death to look like an accident?
What will Laertes put on his sword?
What is the backup plan if the sword fails?
Laertes says he'd cut Hamlet's throat even where?
Laertes would kill in a church. Whom did Hamlet spare at prayer?
How does Ophelia die?
Who brings the news of Ophelia's death?

tracks.name: The Graveyard
summary: Gravediggers crack jokes. Hamlet meets
an old friend's skull. Then, a funeral.
beats: Two gravediggers joke while they dig.
Should she get a church burial? Rich folks do.
A skull! It's Yorick, the old court jester.
'Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio.'
Ophelia's funeral. Laertes jumps in the grave!
Hamlet jumps in too. Brawl in the grave.

questions.q: What do the gravediggers argue about?
What do the joking gravediggers bring to this dark scene?
Who was Yorick?
Holding Yorick's skull, what does Hamlet realize?
Hamlet says even Alexander the Great turned to...
Why are Ophelia's funeral rites cut short?
What does Hamlet only learn at the graveyard?
Who leaps into Ophelia's grave first?
Why does Hamlet leap into the grave too?
'Sweets to the sweet. Farewell!' Who said it, scattering flowers?

tracks.name: The Duel
summary: The rigged duel. Poison everywhere.
Almost no one makes it out.
beats: Hamlet swapped the letter. R&G die instead.
Hamlet accepts the duel. 'Readiness is all.'
Gertrude drinks the poisoned cup. Oh no.
Laertes nicks Hamlet. Swords swap. Both hit.
Laertes confesses. Hamlet kills Claudius at last.
'The rest is silence.' Fortinbras takes over.

questions.q: How did Hamlet send Rosencrantz and Guildenstern to die?
'The readiness is all.' What is Hamlet ready for?
Why does Hamlet apologize to Laertes before the duel?
Who drinks from the poisoned cup by mistake?
Why doesn't Claudius try harder to stop Gertrude drinking?
How is Laertes killed?
Who reveals the king's plot before dying?
What does Hamlet beg Horatio to do?
Who takes the throne of Denmark at the end?
'Good night, sweet prince.' Who said it?
